title: Next action per task
statement: The system shall keep exactly one next action per task, proposed when an agent run or chat session on the task ends and shown first when the next one starts.
rationale: One concrete cue written at stop time is the most reliable way to resume work after a gap.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tasks have a next_action field of at most 280 characters that names a file path, command or record id
When an agent run ends, a line starting 'NEXT:' in its final message becomes a pending proposal on the task, which the user accepts, edits or rejects in the task drawer
A coding-agent brief and the task drawer show the task's next_action first, with the date it was set
Starting a new chat or closing the chat panel after a changeset was applied in the session asks the chat agent once to propose updated next actions and a snapshot Next

source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe
